status: Read-only feasibility audit; no Wi-Fi crypto model implemented or validated

primary_source.scope: Read-only feasibility audit; no keys or crypto model implementation

key_valid_bitmap.semantics: Bit corresponding to key slot is set/cleared/tested; maximum valid slot count has not been established

key_table.semantics: Peer address and encoded configuration occupy the first two words; key bytes are copied beginning at +8, rounded up to four bytes; clear writes all ten words zero

per_interface_crypto_control.proven_field: hal_crypto_mgmt_rx_enabled selects interface control word and tests bit17; full encryption modes remain unmodelled

using_key_index_read.limit: A raw source getter alone does not establish when this state updates

source_proven_packet_preparation.observation: Software adds cipher-dependent overhead to packet and DMA length, manipulates descriptor EOF/control fields and another packet buffer. Thus key-register latching alone is insufficient to reproduce secure TX. Cipher mapping and hardware input/output transformations need separate proof.

required_work_not_implemented: Confirm exact pinned-stock key-slot/cipher selection and TX/RX crypto metadata against actual register and packet traces
Implement genuine CCMP/TKIP transformations with packet numbers, replay and authentication-failure handling; validate against independent vectors and wire captures
Preserve hardware-visible crypto status, RX length and descriptor flags rather than merely passing encrypted bytes as cleartext
For a secure virtual access point, implement an actual WPA/RSN/EAPOL authenticator that exchanges frames with the stock guest; no fabricated success callback
Exercise secure, hidden and persisted credential workflows separately; hidden/open scanning and storage are not proof of WPA
limits: No keys, credentials or user packet captures included
Existing peer encrypted-frame rejection remains unchanged
No secure-network acceptance or physical entropy/timing claim
